g.text: 01 / DR ECONOMIC VULNERABILITY INDEX
Automated weekly economic-vulnerability tracker for the Dominican Republic, scoring national risk from macro indicators.
Ingests BCRD, Banco Central and FRED data into a composite 0-100 stress score with automated data-quality enforcement.
PYTHON · GITHUB ACTIONS · PANDAS · OPENPYXL · CHART.JS · DASHBOARD
02 / U.S. RECESSION PROBABILITY DASHBOARD
Gradient boosting classifier trained on 421 months of FRED data to score U.S. recession probability weekly.
Fully automated pipeline — ingestion, scoring and redeployment — orchestrated end to end with Prefect and GitHub Actions.
PYTHON · SCIKIT-LEARN · MLFLOW · PREFECT · STREAMLIT
03 / PALIMPSEST
Layout-preserving document translation: same pages, same artwork, same typography — only the words change.
Grew out of translating 30+ scanned Spanish financial and legal documents into formatted English deliverables.
PYTHON · FASTAPI · REACT · OCR · DOCUMENT TRANSLATION
04 / FINANCIAL DOCUMENT DIGITIZATION
Data-extraction pipeline built at JMMB Puesto de Bolsa to digitize audited financial statements from scanned, image-only filings.
Consolidated FY2023–2025 filings for JMMB and 14 peer broker-dealers into one workbook for cross-entity benchmarking.
PYTHON · PYPDFIUM2 · EXCEL AUTOMATION · CAPITAL MARKETS
05 / DR FREE-TRADE-ZONE MARKET RESEARCH
Data-driven market research presentation synthesizing 10+ government and industry sources on the DR free-trade-zone sector.
Quantified regional investment concentration to brief JMMB's investment strategy team on a growth opportunity.
PYTHON-PPTX · MARKET RESEARCH · CNZFE · BANCO CENTRAL · EY
06 / HR APPLICANT-SCREENING PIPELINE
Automated HR applicant-screening pipeline built at La Sociedad & Partners, processing 100+ candidate CVs.
Cut manual review time and standardized status tracking for the hiring team using Power Automate and Claude.
POWER AUTOMATE · CLAUDE · AUTOMATION · HR TECH
07 / GLOBAL AVIATION RECOVERY ANALYSIS
Analyzed 6 years of passenger traffic across the world's 20 busiest airports to identify post-pandemic recovery patterns.
Built a data pipeline to clean and reconcile traffic records with structural gaps from pandemic-era travel restrictions.
R · TIDYVERSE · GGPLOT2 · TIME SERIES
08 / COURSEWORK & FOUNDATIONS
Collection of Data Science and Computer Science coursework spanning OOP, data structures, and exploratory data analysis.
Covers linked lists, trees and tries with Big-O analysis, plus statistical modeling and simulation projects in R and Python.
PYTHON · R · JUPYTER · OOP · DATA STRUCTURES · EDA
